title: TCP: Update RST diagnostic payload for draft-17
description:
Update the RST diagnostic payload dissector from draft-15 to [draft-boucadair-tcpm-rst-diagnostic-payload-17](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-boucadair-tcpm-rst-diagnostic-payload/17/). Draft-17 drops the free-description format (magic 0xF317) entirely, leaving only the fixed 8-byte format (magic 0x33AA with reason-code and PEN).

AI-Assisted: no
